en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5473 - Aban ibn Taghlib narrated from Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) that

Imam (as) was asked about a man who made a bequest (waṣiyyah) of something from his wealth.
Imam (as) replied: "The portion specified in the Book of (Imam) Ali (as) is one out of six parts."
